integrity: The claims are supported by an analytical finite-graph proof and a standalone integer checker for dimensions 2 through 6. The finite checker is not an infinite proof; no independent audit or certificate is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Real, finite-dimensional, unweighted coordinate spaces, exactly one spare output coordinate, and \(1\le p<\infty\), \(p\ne2\). No result for the complex case, Hilbert case, or larger codimension. The source already supplies the disjoint-support classification and the topology of fixed-support strata. The contribution assessed is their global gluing, the even-signed Cayley model, exact loop rank, and the Stiefel comparison. Historical priority remains subject to independent literature review.
title: The sparse Stiefel graph of real codimension-one isometries
